# What's the new $6,000 senior deduction worth?

> Free calculator for the new federal 'senior bonus' deduction (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, tax years 2025-2028): up to $6,000 per qualifying taxpayer age 65+ ($12,000 if both spouses qualify), the 6%-per-dollar MAGI phase-out above $75,000 single/HOH/QSS or $150,000 joint, and the married-filing-separately exclusion.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
